_: Build-from-source pin: which ffmpeg.org release tarball CI compiles for every platform. The source SHA-256 is verified against ffmpeg.org's GPG-signed tarball at build time (scripts/build-ffmpeg/verify-source.sh). No per-platform binary URLs — CI produces every platform's static binary from this one source. Trust chain: ffmpeg.org → us. Bumped via `pnpm tsx scripts/bump-ffmpeg-pin.ts --to <version>`.
